tool_args.rationale: The archived spatiotemporal siphon-memory mechanism matches the observed signatures, but its five parameters are underconstrained by the five pilot rows. The available trajectory batch is the relevant discriminating measurement.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter spatiotemporal siphon-memory ODE to the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations for five parameters do not identify the coupled dynamics reliably; the archived mechanism calls for at least eight rows.

considered_alternatives.option: Static siphon or uncoupled memory models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot signatures include both sink-gradient dependence and coupled transient lag; additional trajectory observations can distinguish these mechanisms.
